text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Liqi and Luantou, all aligned...!
Now is the time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go! White Tiger, Guardian of the West!
Special Move: ...—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, I must prevent that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, aaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Thy affinity was ill-matched against the White Tiger's element.
Victory is mine once more~."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... I lost again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I walked past the cafeteria,
Copano Rickey and Wonder Acute were playing
a card game that was apparently popular right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You draw cards to summon characters and take turns battling, but...
choice_data_list: Are you bad at video games, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Ehehe... I don't really do this often, so I guess I'm just lacking experience.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even if I align the landforms and cosmic energies,
I kind of lack the actual ability to demonstrate, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, ye're certainly playin' along nicely, aren't ye?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Because it looks so fun! And I want to have fun playing with everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, that sounds just like little Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll come naturally once you play enough.
Feel free to call on me anytime.
As long as it's not a beep-boop video game, I'm all for it~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned to the trainer's office,
Copano Rickey was laying out the card game from that time...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, hmm...
Learning the rules is hard enough,
but there are so many characters too...
choice_data_list: Want me to join your practice?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
But first, I think I'd like to sort out my thoughts alone?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Staying beaten like this is frustrating!
And I wanna have fun! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
......
It's gonna be a teensy bit tough, though!
choice_data_list: Let's keep at it steadily and take breaks along the way!
How about memorizing it by associating it with everyday things?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's true too!
Should we get some tea and snacks ready?
Just like Ms. Acute does—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Thy affinity was ill-matched against the White Tiger's element.
Victory is mine once more~."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Something close to home, huh...
For me, that would be feng shui, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Was there anything we could link to it?
There were some characters connected to feng shui, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Thy affinity was ill-matched against the White Tiger's element.
Victory is mine once more~."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: She said... attribute...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was only looking at attack power and HP, but...
what do these fire and leaf symbols mean...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, aaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised.
It is as if my daughter has changed...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I finally won—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, having memorized the cards at breakneck speed, Copano Rickey successfully took her revenge...!
choice_data_list: What on earth is the matter?
What on earth is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When you mentioned affinities, Acute-san, I realized!
This was a clash of opposing elements all along!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Water weakens fire qi,
fire weakens metal qi... and so on!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Once I realized it was just like that important relationship in feng shui, I memorized it in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "When it comes to feng shui, I won't lose to anyone! And I won't lose this battle either!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, oh dear.
Did I just inadvertently lend my opponent a helping hand?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's our Rickey-chan for ya~
You're so clever, so amazing~ Here, have a piece of candy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it could be tied to feng shui, she might be capable of anything... It was an incident that made me think just that.
